client.provenance: Unchanged compiled CI ARM64 client reused; current Rust host binaries are independently rebuilt and their source bundle is verified in the guest. Not a current-commit client rebuild or signed release.

behavior: Temporary keys use a separate root-only tmpfs archive; only public metadata is combined with saved entries.
Temporary creation explicitly selects the new key. Removal never selects another account automatically.
Read-only and writable general profiles both preserve RAM-only credential storage.
Existing gateway destruction precedes changing credentials; open sessions reject mutation.
Lock and crash recovery remove RAM credentials, selection and pending files after gateway closure.
Full tmpfs preserves the last published credential archive and selection; no disk fallback.
limits: Synthetic credentials and provider only; no real Abliteration or online Tor conversation.
The external packet capture covers the first persistent A workload, not subsequent ephemeral streams.
Disk canary scans cover the laboratory images, not exhaustive syscall tracing or the entire physical USB.
Byte-identical assertions cover the general LUKS image in ephemeral mode, not the whole USB.
Tests force tmpfs ENOSPC, not physical-memory OOM or power loss.
Nested TCG is a functional laboratory, not a production x86/KVM isolation guarantee.
No claim of erasing every in-memory secret copy.
